rows.name: [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So, are you Machine God Soldiers?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]In one sense we are, and in another we are not.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It is a fact that the weapons you call the Machine God Soldiers[XENO:n ]
were created by our civilisation.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]However, we were born from the Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

By your understanding, it would be correct[XENO:n ]
to say that we are the same as Mechon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]A form of mechanical life born of[XENO:n ]
the Machine God... Is that correct?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

From our perspective, you are forms[XENO:n ]
of organic life born of the Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Life born of the Machine God...[XENO:n ]
So there is life here, just like on Giant God?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Explain to us why you invaded our world.[XENO:n ]
What did we ever do to you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I understand your feelings, but please...[XENO:n ]
There is much yet to tell you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Onii-chan, please hear her out.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
But...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
These Machina... They're good people.[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Fiorung?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You do not look fully functional.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Ever since she was given this body,[XENO:n ]
she hasn't been feeling too good.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
But we honestly don't know what to do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Do you mean to tell me you are not Machina?[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Why didn't you tell me sooner?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I'm OK, really.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Nonsense! I am a doctor.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Do not worry. I specialise in[XENO:n ]
people in your situation.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]Just as I thought. You were[XENO:n ]
transformed into a Face unit.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

You are experiencing a functional[XENO:n ]
breakdown in multiple locations.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I will take her to my laboratory.[XENO:n ]
The chief will answer your questions.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
He is waiting for you in Junks.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
For us?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
We will speak later.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk, I'm...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Fiorung...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Don't worry. I'll keep an eye on her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Thanks.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
